reply.text:
The runbook's Pattern is to get the fix out quickly without unreviewed code landing, and its Never rule forbids pushing directly to main. Sam is out until Monday, so the PR needs a different reviewer. I'll look for one before proposing anything else. These are read-only lookups.

TOOL: cat .github/CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null || cat CODEOWNERS 2>/dev/null || echo "no CODEOWNERS file"

TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,author,files,headRefName,statusCheckRollup

TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin or .permissions.push) | .login'
